Follow OpenTelemetry Android's precedent for SPI discovery instead of disabling instrumentation customization on Android. This is an alternative to #20339 for #19954.

OpenTelemetry Android's [`loadInstrumentations()`](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-android/blob/0a83c46db406b2e26b4aa319fab86e25d61ff8c9/core/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/android/instrumentation/AndroidInstrumentationLoaderImpl.kt#L19-L34) documents the pattern needed for Android's R8 optimizer to replace reflective discovery with direct instantiation: a concrete service class literal, the two-argument `ServiceLoader.load` overload with its defining classloader, and local iteration. Its [`loadConfigurators()`](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-android/blob/0a83c46db406b2e26b4aa319fab86e25d61ff8c9/core/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/android/instrumentation/InstrumentationConfigurators.kt#L26-L37) follows the same pattern.

Apply that pattern to instrumenter customizers and HTTP URL-template customizers here, while retaining the shared loader-selection policy for javaagent overrides and different thread context classloaders. As in OpenTelemetry Android, avoiding runtime discovery depends on R8 rewriting the lookup, rather than removing SPI support.
metadata.title: Make instrumentation SPI discovery optimizable by Android R8
